sources.snippet: You can monitor the number of preemption requests through Prometheus metrics exposed by vLLM. Additionally, you can log the cumulative number of preemption requests by setting disable_log_stats=False. In vLLM V1, the default preemption mode is RECOMPUTE rather than SWAP, as recomputation has lower overhead in the V1 architecture.
